label: Sixth outpatient illness - How many times did you visit the hospital for treatment for this illness/condition? - at age 68 years
meta_rows: Sixth outpatient illness - How many times did you visit the hospital for treatment for this illness/condition? - at age 68 years
Hospital out-patient data asked in the 2014 postal questionnaire.
cat_rows: This category contains data from the questionnaires on hospital out-patient admissions. This is for treatments and surgery at the hospital where the participant went home the same day and did not spend a night in hospital.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
